recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. If generated integer64.profile.json output regresses to System.Integer later, investigate the Kindling generator or generated build output rather than adding a redundant FHIR core source change.
issue_request: FHIR-46522 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction requesting that integer64 stop being represented as http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.Integer, because FHIRPath Integer is 32-bit, and instead reference the FHIRPath 64-bit Long type once available for R6.
initial_application: FHIR-26389 first added the visible FHIR.integer64 -> System.Long mapping table row in source/fhirpath.html via commit a1a727070c2cd8bfed2507ea7ae0ad84f3e88a73. FHIR-46522 was later applied through PR #3797; commit 0b26d1b1862f0a3028062a690fa09da278674bb2 added http://hl7.org/fhirpath/System.Long to source/terminologies/codesystem-fhirpath-types.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-26542 records the FHIRPath-side decision to add System.Long. FHIR-I minutes on 2024-08-12 listed FHIR-46522 as a technical correction tied to R6 FHIRPath work. Zulip discussions in July and October 2025 confirm that the issue waited for FHIRPath Long, then Kindling handled the generated primitive profile type while the FHIR core CodeSystem update was committed.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The build-scoped source/fhirpath.html page maps FHIR.integer64 to System.Long, source/terminologies/codesystem-fhirpath-types.xml includes System.Long for value-set use, and the combined branch already contains those changes. No current checked-in core source hunk remains to change.
